tasks.short: Forecast menu-based staff, equipment and supplies

steps.what: Review the master menu and estimate expected portions and service conditions
Calculate supply quantities, staff hours and equipment requirements from the menu plan
Adjust the forecast for operational constraints and approve the resource plan

tasks.design: Configure menu quantities and existing capacity rates in {OPS_SYSTEM} or the controlled {SPREADSHEET}. The supervisor supplies demand assumptions and adjusts the calculated resource draft; no individual employee allocation or autonomous ordering follows.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scaling recipe and capacity figures across a master menu requires repeated arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Recipe-cost systems already support ingredient rollups; resource scaling can use ordinary arithmetic where local rates are verified.
tasks.still_hard: Predict demand and recognise bottlenecks that averages conceal.
tasks.human_edge: Adjust expectations for events, service format and equipment constraints.

ambition.what: Compare a low-demand and high-demand resource scenario before service.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor can recalculate scenarios more easily while retaining planning judgement.

reach.task: Validate recipe quantities and equipment bottlenecks
reach.learn: State batch yields and capacity limits explicitly

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls ingredient prices into portion costs, supporting structured recipe arithmetic.
Tenzo forecasts sales and managers adjust forecasts before scheduling; local resource formulas are a separate proposed design.

assumptions: S1 produces menu_version, service_period, expected_portions, service_format and known constraints; its 35% includes checking bookings and manually entering assumptions.

Chef supplies recipe_id, ingredient quantities and batch_yield; supervisor validates labour_minutes_per_batch and equipment_capacity from actual local practice. Initial capture and verification are included in rollout; recurring changes are counted as upkeep below.
S2 remaining time includes capturing assumptions, checking units and resolving absent capacity or recipe fields. Missing rates require manual estimation, not a guessed structured feed.
Test native menu scaling first; only arithmetic shrinks, not demand judgement, recipe validation or final operational adjustment.
unknowns: Whether local recipe and capacity records are current
How often service constraints invalidate standard rates
research_questions: Do calculated requirements match actual needs after manager adjustments, without adding more data upkeep than they save?

already_counted.description: Enter assumptions and inspect calculated quantities and capacity conflicts

incremental.description: Revalidate labour and capacity rates when operations change
Maintain recipe quantities and batch yields

approvals.approved_version: Supervisor approves exact resource forecast revision with menu, demand and rate versions; edits to any input require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=35+14+30=79; gross=21%; minus 3 focal upkeep gives 18% net. Low: recipe or capacity data require too much repair or current scaling already exists. High: repeated scaling falls while demand assessment and final judgement remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate hospital diets, trays and trolley delivery

steps.what: Assess patient nutritional needs within competence and clarify authorised dietary instructions
Plan regular and special menus against verified patient dietary requirements
Supervise diet tray assembly and oversee trolley delivery to the correct patients

tasks.design: Keep the existing {OTHER} hospital meal system and approved menus in {DOCS}. The supervisor clarifies dietary requirements with authorised clinical staff, plans within approved guidance and verifies tray and delivery matching; no model interprets prescriptions or invents diet substitutions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient requirements and locations change, with potentially harmful consequences from mismatches.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing meal records support coordination; the digest establishes no safe automated replacement for this hospital workflow.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting dietary information and last-minute changes.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty and obtain clinical clarification before a meal is supplied.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor retains meal coordination within competence; clinical prescribing authority is unchanged.

reach.learn: Escalate conflicts and distinguish preferences from prescribed restrictions

evidence.claim: Patient meal coordination needs verified dietary instructions and direct tray/delivery checks; no hospital-specific automation is established by this digest.

assumptions: Authorised clinical staff produce diet instructions and current patient location information under the existing clinical process; their work is unchanged. Supervisor checks identity, currency and conflicting information in s1 and s3 rather than assuming perfect feeds.
Kitchen staff assemble trays and delivery staff move trolleys under the existing process; their physical effort is unchanged outside focal supervisory time.
Clinical assessment outside the supervisor’s competence stays with qualified staff. Missing or contradictory instructions are clarified manually before affected meal delivery.
No new system means zero incremental upkeep; all existing checking remains in the baseline.
unknowns: Which clinical and food-service responsibilities are authorised locally
How current patient and dietary instructions are communicated
research_questions: Where do changes to patient diets or locations most often reach food service late?

already_counted.description: Check tray and patient matching and resolve exceptions

incremental.description: No new hospital meal application or data flow

approvals.approved_version: Supervisor checks exact current patient meal-plan revision and assembled tray against current identity and delivery details before release; dietary or location changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=30+25+45=100. Assessment clarification, menu planning and supervision retain effort; no capture, clinical or delivery work is credited as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record production, operational and personnel data

steps.what: Gather and verify production, operational and personnel facts required by the forms
Record verified data on the specified forms and check saved entries

tasks.design: Configure the specified forms in {OPS_SYSTEM} and restricted {HCM} views so the supervisor enters each verified fact once. Reuse entered date, site and shift headers; keep personnel information separately permissioned and preserve original observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper headers and repeated copying add recording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can validate required fields and reuse entered headers without interpreting the facts.
tasks.still_hard: Verify source observations and handle incomplete or sensitive entries.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a recorded value does not reflect the real event.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor records verified facts with less repetition; access and reporting obligations stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Use consistent units and source references

evidence.claim: Orbisk records food waste, demonstrating one production-data category rather than automated capture of every operational or personnel fact.
Native forms can reduce repeated headers and copying; this specific saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Supervisor produces event_date, site, shift, record_type, observed_value, unit and source_reference in s1, including checking source logs and manually resolving omissions; its full 50% remains.
S2 remaining 35 baseline units include first capture, reading back entries and correcting errors. Form defaults never create observations or infer personnel data.
Administration supplies approved form definitions. Missing source facts stay pending for manual clarification; test native forms before custom work.
This is source recording; report generation and analytical grouping are separate downstream tasks and do not repeat the capture saving.
unknowns: Which specified forms are mandatory and already digital
Which fields may be reused across forms
research_questions: Does single capture reduce recording time after observation, correction and permission maintenance are counted?

incremental.description: Check changes to form definitions and defaults
Maintain restricted form views and field definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=50+35=85; gross=15%; minus 1 focal upkeep gives 14% net. Low: native forms already capture once. High: repeated headers and copying shrink; fact gathering and initial capture remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Handle personnel decisions, orientation, schedules and time sheets

steps.what: Perform hiring and firing actions within authority after reviewing facts and consulting HR
Provide employee orientation and training and create workable staff schedules
Organize employee time sheets and resolve missing or disputed entries

tasks.design: Use a native {HCM} period view to organise existing time entries and show omissions. Keep hiring, firing, orientation, training, schedule decisions and time-entry dispute resolution with authorised people; no worker ranking or automatic pay release is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding time sheets across individual records adds clerical work to broader supervisory duties.
tasks.enabler_now: Native period views can group existing entries without making employment decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Employee concerns, disputed facts and fair staffing decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Hear explanations and provide practical support.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor sees time-entry gaps more clearly while existing employment and payroll authority stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Use documented facts and clear decision boundaries

evidence.claim: A native time-entry view can group existing records; no digest source establishes this specific clerical improvement.

assumptions: Workers produce dated time entries under the existing capture process; their unchanged effort is outside focal supervisor labour. Supervisor checks missing or disputed entries and captures corrections within s3 remaining 16 units; no clean approved feed is assumed.
Supervisor confirms availability when creating schedules in s2; that capture and judgement retain full time.
Test existing HCM views first. The change only reduces locating and sorting time sheets, not employee conversations or approving payment.
Orientation and training overlap the dedicated training task, and verified time sheets overlap payroll support; these baseline views must not be added together in a role roll-up.
unknowns: Which native time-period view is available
Which personnel actions require HR approval
research_questions: Does a single period view reduce searching after all exception resolution and correction entry is included?

incremental.description: Check period-view filters and report missing entries
Maintain time-view permissions and period rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=30+50+16=96; gross=4%; minus 0.5 focal upkeep gives 3.5% net. Low: time sheets are already grouped. High: locating and sorting shorten while personnel judgement, training, scheduling and dispute resolution retain time; overlapping tasks are not additive.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Menu arithmetic, repeated form entry and time-sheet lookup can become lighter while clinical coordination and employee decisions remain human.
role.ambitious_version: Compare resource scenarios and keep operational records current without automating clinical or employment judgement.
